POLICIES & CUSTOMER CARE

Shipping & Delivery Policy

Delivery areas, dispatch times and support for your Madikar Taila order.

Policy effective: September 1, 2026

On this page

Where we deliverOrder processing and packagingEstimated delivery timesShipping chargesOrder trackingDelivery attempts and address detailsDamage, leakage or lost shipmentsDelays outside our control

01Where we deliver

We deliver to residential and commercial addresses across Hubballi–Dharwad through our local distribution network, and to serviceable PIN codes across India through recognised courier partners, including Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC and India Post Speed Post.

02Order processing and packaging

Allow 1–2 business days for batch packing and leak-proof sealing. Orders placed on Sundays or public holidays are processed on the next working day. Oil bottles and pantry products are packed with sealed closures and protective cushioning.

03Estimated delivery times

Delivery estimates by destination
DestinationEstimated delivery
Hubballi & DharwadSame day or next day
Karnataka & South India2–4 business days
Rest of India3–6 business days, depending on PIN code

These are estimates. PIN code accessibility, weather, regional restrictions and courier conditions may affect delivery. Please contact customer care to confirm timing for your order.

04Shipping charges

  • Hubballi–Dharwad orders of ₹499 or more: free home delivery.
  • Local orders below ₹499: the delivery fee is ₹0.
  • National courier delivery: charges depend on parcel weight and destination postal zone and are confirmed before payment.

05Order tracking

Once your parcel is handed to the courier, tracking details are shared using your registered contact number via SMS or WhatsApp. For a tracking update, contact customer care with your order reference.

06Delivery attempts and address details

Courier partners generally make 2–3 delivery attempts before returning a parcel to the mill. Provide a complete street address, useful landmarks, a reachable phone number and a correct six-digit PIN code. Re-dispatch charges may apply if a parcel is returned because the address is invalid or unreachable.

07Damage, leakage or lost shipments

Report damage, leakage or tampering within 48 hours of delivery. Send clear photographs or a short unboxing video showing the outer box, shipping label and affected product to customer care, together with your order reference. Verified transit damage is eligible for a free replacement or full refund.

For missing or lost shipments, contact us so we can investigate with the courier. See the Cancellation & Refund Policy for claim requirements.

08Delays outside our control

Severe weather, transport strikes, regional bandhs, festivals, courier congestion and government restrictions can delay delivery. Our team will provide updated estimates when such delays affect your order.
